first_error.behavior: Empty clipped customer windows replaced by the full horizon without forcing the optional pair inactive.

source_evidence_type: ACP create payload, not real source export

candidate.hypothesis: Avoid optimizing impossible optional service admitted by a full-horizon replacement for empty public windows; reduce later route/group loss while retaining the original relaxation and postprocessing.

replacements.old: - If a problem statement gives explicit pickup and dropoff time-window formulas, implement those formulas directly. Service time belongs in the time transit from a node to the next node; do not change the stated window formula to compensate for service time unless the problem explicitly says to.
replacements.new: - If a problem statement gives explicit pickup and dropoff time-window formulas, implement those formulas directly. Service time belongs in the time transit from a node to the next node; do not change the stated window formula to compensate for service time unless the problem explicitly says to. Intersect windows with operating bounds. An empty intersection makes the optional pair inactive, and its connected set inactive when all-or-none service applies; replacing it with the full horizon admits infeasible service.

candidate.source_note: Pinned official optional-visit API supports inactive nodes. Empty-window handling follows the public time-window contract; grouped relaxation is not replaced with global active equalities.

limits: Original main, solver source and report.json were not retained/exported; ACP creates/prints are trace evidence only. No source or report reconstructed as actual output.
The two empty windows are computed from public input. No raw routes remain to uniquely link those two requests to dropped routes or to establish sole causality.
Original grouped relaxation/postprocess guide already exists and was broadly followed; its final all-or-none closure was initially incomplete, then corrected at a cost in served trips.
Original source uses PARALLEL_CHEAPEST_INSERTION despite the existing AUTOMATIC default; search quality may depend on heuristic/time behavior. No search strategy or budget changed in Skill.
Original search objective cost is weighted per inactive pickup in OR-Tools9.11; treating it as a literal skipped-trip count is unsupported for unequal group sizes.

Reference quality test status was read, but reference_oracle, reference solution and threshold values were not read or used. Verifier entry tests except the reference fixture/test body were inspected; full opaque reference scoring logic remains uninspected.
Actual final plan passed six feasibility/accounting tests but failed quality. This is a valid normal assertion, not an infrastructure failure or a reason for supplemental regrading.
Fresh PASS would not prove original guidance absent or sole causality.
